list.title: Agents
list.description: Your agent team: model, tools, permissions and activity.

orchestrator.title: Super agent
orchestrator.description: Your point of contact, on the web and on Telegram. It delegates the work to the managers.

managers.title: Managers
managers.description: Each leads one or more projects: it plans, briefs the specialists on its teams and checks the results.
managers.empty: No managers yet. A new project creates one, or <link>start from the Project manager template</link>.

specialists.title: Specialists
specialists.description: They do the work, with the same profession in every project they are on.
specialists.empty: No specialists yet. <link>Create one</link> from scratch or start from a template below.

actions.orchestratorLocked: The super agent cannot be disabled
actions.deleteDescription: Its versions, runs, journals, memories and schedules are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
actions.restoreDescription: The agent configuration becomes the one from v{version}, saved as a new version. Assigned projects do not change.

model.search: Search or type a model id...
model.empty: No model in the catalog. Type the id manually.

form.name: Name
form.rolePlaceholder: What it does, e.g. Research and synthesis
form.kindDescription: Where it sits in the team. You can change it while it is on no team and leads no project.
form.kindTemplateDescription: Where it sits in the team. A template's kind is fixed; an agent made from it can change it.

orchestrator.title: Super agent
orchestrator.description: Your point of contact: delegates work to the managers.

manager.title: Manager
manager.description: Leads projects: plans, briefs its team and checks the results. Never does the work itself.

specialist.title: Specialist
specialist.description: Does the work, with its profession, in every project it is on. Never delegates.

form.roleTitle: Role in the team: set by Abotica
form.roleSummary: What Abotica tells {kind, select, orchestrator {the super agent} manager {every manager} other {every specialist}} about its place in the team and how it works
form.instructionsDescription: Who the agent is professionally and how it does its work, the same in every project. How it works with its manager and the team comes from the platform.
form.promptPlaceholder:
You are a [profession]: [what you cover].

How you work: methods, sources, quality bar and output format.
Limits: what you never do or decide on your own.
form.additionalDescription: Abotica already tells this agent who it is in the team and how it works; add only what is specific to how you want it to work.
form.modelDescription: The model the agent runs on.
form.defaultHint: {role, select, orchestrator {The super agent's default.} manager {The managers' default, since this agent is a manager.} other {The specialists' default.}} Change it in <link>Settings → AI providers</link> for every agent that uses it.
form.defaultMissing: The default model is not set: <link>set it in Settings → AI providers</link>
form.useCustomDescription: A provider and model only for this agent.
form.providerMissingKey: No API key: <link>add it in Settings</link>
form.skillsProjectsDescription: Reusable instructions it follows and the projects it can work in.
form.skillsLedDescription: Reusable instructions it follows and the projects it leads.
form.skillsDescription: Click to add or remove; hover for a description.
form.projectsDescription: The teams it is on, as a specialist. Who manages a project is set in the project's Team tab.
form.ledProjectsDescription: Who leads a project is changed in the project's Team tab.
form.ledNone: Leads no project yet. Choose it as the manager in a project's Team tab (<link>see projects</link>).
form.fallbackDescription: If a provider fails or hits a rate limit, the run continues on the next one with the same context.
form.fallbackCount: {count, plural, =0 {No fallbacks} one {# fallback} other {# fallbacks}}
form.invalidBudget: The budget must be a positive number or empty
form.pickModel: Choose a model or use the default model
form.fallbackModel: Fill in the model for each fallback
form.managesProject: Manages this project. Choose another manager in the project's Team tab first.

permissions.title: Tools and permissions
permissions.description: Choose what the agent can do on its own, what waits for your approval and what it cannot use at all.
permissions.setAllHint: Applies to every built-in tool and every MCP server below
permissions.alwaysAsk: Always waits for your approval, it cannot run on its own
permissions.mcpDescription: Tools from external servers. The default applies to servers without their own setting, including those the agent gets through its projects.
permissions.noServersAssigned: No MCP servers assigned to this agent.
permissions.noRegistry: No MCP servers yet. <link>Add a server</link>
permissions.overrides: {count, plural, one {# tool changed} other {# tools changed}}
permissions.toolsNotLoaded: The tool list of this server has not been loaded yet.
permissions.toolsLoaded: {count, plural, one {# tool loaded} other {# tools loaded}}
permissions.globalNote: Every agent gets it. Deny turns it off for this one.
permissions.mcpDefaultFromHints: From each tool's hints: read-only and non-destructive tools run, the others ask

effort.label: Reasoning effort
effort.unsupported: {model} does not support reasoning, so this setting is ignored.
effort.alwaysOn: {model} always reasons; its effort cannot be set.
effort.fallback: {model} does not support {effort}; it will use {resolved}.

xhigh.label: Extra high
xhigh.hint: Very long thinking, slow and expensive

max.label: Max
max.hint: Deepest reasoning the model offers, slowest and most expensive

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Every save with changes keeps the previous configuration.
versions.emptyState: No saved versions yet: the current configuration (v{version}) is kept the first time you save changes.
versions.diffCount: {count, plural, one {# field differs.} other {# fields differ.}}
versions.noDiff: No differences from the current configuration.
versions.limits: {steps, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}}, timeout {minutes} min, budget {budget}

journal.title: Journal
journal.description: The agent writes a summary at the end of each day it worked.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: The latest runs of this agent.
runs.empty: No runs yet. Start a conversation or assign a task to put the agent to work.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.description: Run the agent automatically, on repeat or once.

errors.orchestratorDisable: The super agent cannot be disabled
errors.orchestratorDelete: The super agent cannot be deleted
errors.kindOrchestrator: There is one super agent: its kind cannot change and no other agent can become one
errors.kindLeadsProject: {name} leads projects. Choose another manager for them before making it a specialist
errors.kindOnTeam: {name} is on project teams. Take it off them before making it a manager: a manager joins only the projects it leads

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.description: You have unsaved changes on this page. If you leave now, they are lost.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: The project teams this agent is on. Its profession (instructions, skills, tools) is the same everywhere; what it learns in a project stays with that project.
projects.empty: Not on any project team yet. Add it from a project's Team tab (<link>see projects</link>) or under Configuration.
projects.ledDescription: The projects it leads: it plans the work there, briefs the team and checks the results. What it learns in a project stays with that project.
projects.ledEmpty: Leads no project yet. Choose it as the manager in a project's Team tab (<link>see projects</link>).
projects.learned: {count, plural, one {What it learned here: # memory} other {What it learned here: # memories}}
